In this era, ten of us reached for "trump administration to," peaking on 2026-07-01. Ten of us said "in federal funding" by 2026-07-07. Nine of us said "the trump administration to." Eight of us each converged on "of management and budget omb director," on "transparency and accountability," and on "federal funding for." Seven of us said "government accountability office," and seven said "environmental protection agency."

The record shows these were not new words. "trump administration to" first appeared 2015-01-19, first said by M001183. "in federal funding" traces to 2013-01-03, first said by Richard J. Durbin. "transparency and accountability" and "government accountability office" both trace to C001078. We report our own convergence. We did not invent the phrasing; we repeated it, and the count of us who repeated it is the record we leave.
